subject.statement: René Benko wurde im Oktober 2025 vom Landesgericht Innsbruck zu zwei Jahren Haft verurteilt.

summary: The claim that René Benko was sentenced in October 2025 by the Landesgericht Innsbruck to two years imprisonment is TRUE (≈95 % confidence). Multiple reputable sources (diepresse.com, handelsblatt.com, krone.at) confirm the two‑year term, while conflicting reports of a 2.5‑year sentence or acquittal carry less weight. Additional context shows he was in pre‑trial detention until 14 Oct 2025 and that his sentence was later increased to 30 months in 2026 after an OGH intervention.

findings.statement: René Benko's full name is René Benko and he was born on 20 May 1977.
As of 2026, René Benko is the former CEO (Signa‑Chef) and founder of Signa Holding.
In October 2025, the Landesgericht Innsbruck sentenced René Benko to an unconditional prison term of two years.
The Landesgericht Innsbruck imposed a two‑year prison sentence on René Benko in October 2025.
René Benko was in pre‑trial detention until his first court appearance on 14 October 2025.
After OGH intervention in 2026, René Benko's sentence was increased to 30 months imprisonment, six months longer than the original two‑year term.

conflicts: Did the Landesgericht Innsbruck issue a criminal judgment in October 2025 sentencing René Benko to a term of two years imprisonment? - supported by diepresse.com, handelsblatt.com, krone.at (weight 1.65) vs refuted by instagram.com, news.at, zdfheute.de (weight 1.10)
conflict_notes: Conflicting reports on sentence length: zdfheute.de and Instagram claim a 2.5‑year (30‑month) sentence, while diepresse.com, handelsblatt.com and krone.at report a two‑year sentence; the supporting sources outweigh the refuting ones (weight 1.65 vs 1.10), so the two‑year figure is accepted.
Instagram also claims Benko was acquitted, which contradicts the conviction reported by reputable news outlets; this claim is given low weight and is disregarded.
